task: Add an auditable machine-safety gate to Mastering Director before autonomous mastering candidates can advance

contract: Mastering analysis can explicitly estimate inter-sample true peak with 4x polyphase oversampling.
Mastering safety rejects a true-peak ceiling violation, excessive crest loss, excessive width shift, negative stereo correlation, or missing true-peak evidence.
A machine-safe mastering candidate remains pending_human_review by default because mastering is subjectively audible.
baseline_eligible remains false until a later explicit human-listening acceptance transition.
MasteringDirector render reports before/after true peak, protected-regression evidence, uncertainty and the safety verdict.

validation.manual_true_peak_smoke: 4x oversampled true peak on the mastering-workbench synthetic tone was finite and 0.0055 dB above sample peak

current_cleanup_baseline.note: Balance-transparent Ptitsa cleanup is still outside the accepted baseline until human RAW/CLEAN listening accepts it, especially both vocals.

next_studio_goal.task: Propagate limiter and loudness-budget diagnostics into the same mastering safety decision so final limiter GR and loudness-target evidence cannot be bypassed before human listening.
